newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares slide, further declines seen.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares slide, further declines seen.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.5 percent on Wednesday and market participants said the gradual decline was likely to continue because of the uncertainty surrounding the return of foreign investors.
"Shares will continue to decline slowly until banks open the first custodian accounts (for foreign investors), which may happen as early as next week," one trader said.

The Bank of Slovenia last month said that foreigners were required to open custodian accounts at local banks if they wanted to trade in Slovenian securities. Since the announcement, the blue chip SBI index has shed 16.7 percent.
* The SBI index fell 6.91 points to 1,378.78.
* Bank SKB was most actively traded, closing 1.12 percent lower at 57,200 on volume of 1,253 shares.
